[[ファイル:Yama-jinja (Toyooka) - Goshinboku.jpg|サムネイル|Sacred magnolia tree]]
{{nihongo|'''Yama Shrine'''|山神社}} is a shrine in {{ill|Hidaka, Hyōgo|Q5751503|qid=Q5751503|lt=Hidaka-chō}}, {{ill|Toyooka, Hyōgo|Q696388|qid=Q696388}}, {{ill|Hyōgo Prefecture|Q130290|qid=Q130290}}. It is a {{ill|Shikinaisha|lt=Shikinaisha|qid=Q134917286}} ({{ill|Myōjin Taisha|fr|Myōjin Taisha|ja|名神大社|simple|Myōjin Taisha|zh|名神大社|qid=Q9610964}}), and its former {{ill|Shakaku|Q10444029|qid=Q10444029}} was {{ill|Son-sha|Q134917284|qid=Q134917284}}. It is one of the ten myōjin taisha in Tajima. {{nihongo|'''Yama Shrine'''|山神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Tajima Province]].

== Overview ==
The Yama Shrine sacred grove, designated a city natural property, is magnificent, with giant Japanese magnolia trees growing across its broad precincts.

== Enshrined deity ==
{{ill|Kukunochi|de|Kukunoshi|es|Kukunochi|it|Kukunochi|ja|ククノチ|zh|久久能智|qid=Q10749920|lt=Kukunochi-no-Mikoto}} (くくのちのみこと)

== About official shrines of Tajima Province ==
'Engishiki' 3 (Rinji-sai), myōjin festival article [28]

Myōjin festival, 285 seats. One seat at Awaga Shrine, two at Yabu Shrine, eight at Izushi Shrine.
One seat at Yama Shrine, one at To Shrine, one at Ikazuchi Shrine.
One seat at [木蜀]椒 Shrine, one at Kaijin Shrine.
All above are in Tajima Province.

== Location information ==
; Location
:* Yamamiya 409-3, Hidaka-chō, Toyooka, Hyogo
; Transportation
:* Bus
:** From {{ill|Ebara Station|Q871691|qid=Q871691}} (JR West San'in Main Line), get off at Yamamiya ({{ill|Zentan Bus|Q11389110|qid=Q11389110}} Kannabe Kōgen Line bound for Higashi-Kōchi), about 23 minutes, then 4 minutes on foot.
:* Car
:** From Nifu intersection on {{ill|Japan National Route 312|Q6157205|qid=Q6157205}}, go west on {{ill|Japan National Route 482|Q6157664|qid=Q6157664}}, about 14 minutes.
